ideas.name: Kids-room blackout clip-on panel set
ideas.concept: Reusable, no-drill blackout fabric panel with edge light-seal flaps and a printed Nordic pattern, sized to common Swedish/Danish window widths (incl. roof-window sizes).
ideas.target_customer: Parents of young children in Nordic homes with bright summer nights, renters.
ideas.problem_solved: Light leaking around blinds wrecks kids' sleep in midnight-sun months; light gaps are a known blind weakness.
ideas.trend_evidence: Unverified: could not run searches. Hypothesis based on known Nordic summer-light sleep complaints and VELUX experience.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Roof-window and standard-size fit library plus printed designs; sizing data from founders' VELUX knowledge.

ideas.name: Desk-window glare shield for home office
ideas.concept: Foldable light-diffusing translucent screen that clips to a window frame or sits on the desk to cut monitor glare while keeping daylight.
ideas.target_customer: Remote workers with desks by windows.
ideas.problem_solved: Glare on screens vs. wanting daylight, without fully closing blinds.
ideas.trend_evidence: Unverified: no searches possible. Remote work persistence is plausible but not evidenced here.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Daylight-engineering spec (measured transmission/diffusion values) and design registration.

ideas.name: Window condensation absorber refill system
ideas.concept: Reusable window-sill moisture-wicking strip with replaceable absorbent refill inserts, sized for Nordic triple-pane sills.
ideas.target_customer: Homeowners and renters with winter window condensation, families with kids' rooms.
ideas.problem_solved: Morning condensation on windows and mould-prone sills (non-medical).
ideas.trend_evidence: Unverified: no searches possible; recurring refill model is the attraction.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Refill subscription, profile fit for Nordic sill sizes; risk: generic absorbers already exist.

ideas.name: Kids' roof-window pull-cord safety and style kit
ideas.concept: Child-safe cord management plus decorative handle extenders for roof windows and blinds in attic kids' rooms.
ideas.target_customer: Parents with attic bedrooms or play rooms.
ideas.problem_solved: Hard-to-reach roof-window handles and blind cord strangulation hazards (EN 13120 context).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand-specific fit for major roof-window models; safety certification credibility.
ideas.tooling_needed: Possibly small plastic part tooling under EUR 2k; verify

ideas.name: Hobby-room daylight check card and film kit
ideas.concept: Printable/physical daylight planner plus adhesive diffusing film strips for hobby rooms and craft desks, teaching placement by window orientation.
ideas.target_customer: Hobbyists (painting, sewing, modelling) in Nordic homes with dark winters.
ideas.problem_solved: Poor, uneven light for detailed work.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Expert daylight guidance content; weak physical moat.

ideas.name: Reusable window draught-seal and insulating film refill pack
ideas.concept: Reusable transparent insulating film frame system with reusable edge seal and annual replacement film, cut for Nordic window sizes.
ideas.target_customer: Renters and homeowners in older Swedish/Danish houses.
ideas.problem_solved: Winter cold and heat loss at old windows.
ideas.trend_evidence: Unverified: no searches possible; energy-cost sensitivity is plausible. Risk of flooded generic market.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Sizing system and reusable frame vs single-use films; weak against Amazon generics.
